name: Route Finder
description: Physics-tick recording, verified replay and bounded solo/shared-dual route search.

auto-resume.name: Resume saved search
auto-resume.description: Find route restores this level search session when compatible. Disable to start a fresh search. Every attempt still starts from the beginning.

show-preview.name: Show forecast path
show-preview.description: Approximate planned path and predicted blocked point. Native GD decides actual collisions.

smooth-search.name: Lower search load
smooth-search.description: Additionally reuse forecasts within one native outer update. Both profiles execute short selected maneuvers and cancel them on native transitions. Recording and replay keep every physics tick.
